metadata.rendererClock: Inner performance.now clock around synchronous band.replace(records). Sparse and jump are single calls. This diagnostic measures only the jump. Excludes correctness checks, dispatch, and layout and paint after the call.
metadata.presentationClock: Stock scale fixture Chromium Element Timing of visible status marker relative to trusted click handler entry. Final cell also hit-tested outside clock.
metadata.order: Fresh Chromium per arm/round. Per round cyclic permutation of arms. Jump first via trusted sparse update and jump clicks; new process for each subsequent visit. This diagnostic measures only the jump.

experiment.description: The same-order control supplies the already-known order only on a fully disjoint, equal-size range whose slot allocator returns the identical array. It skips the general keyed reconciliation and placement pass for that snapshot, and updates the same production row signals in the same order.

replaySources.sourceInputs: Use the Saba slot adapter, generated module, shared pool and direct-slot reference from renderer-grid-slot-keys.json and renderer-grid-speed-references.json. The archived builder/runner scripts contain the original temporary location of their inputs. Update paths when replaying.
